snippet.title: Play of Battle Devlog #1 - Bringing modern era into strategy games
snippet.description:
Welcome to the first devlog for Play of Battle: Systemic War!

With just 100 days left until the demo drops, we're kicking off our devlog series by introducing the core vision behind the game — a modern-era grand strategy experience with real-time tactical combat, deep economic systems, and dynamic geopolitics.

In this episode, we cover:

What Play of Battle: Systemic War is all about

Key inspirations for our design team

The design challenges of adapting modern warfare into a strategy format

Whether you're a fan of grand strategy, tactical real time strategy, or deep systems-driven games, there's something here for you.

 Don’t forget to subscribe and hit the bell to follow our journey to launch!

 Demo release in 100 days — stay tuned.
